import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a boxplot to show the distribution of Sleep Duration based on BMI Category
sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, palette='pastel')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a boxplot to show the distribution of Sleep Duration based on BMI Category
sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, palette='pastel')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
